name: canvas-record
role: Browser canvas recorder to MP4/WebM/GIF/frames via WebCodecs; real-time or stepped
summary: Browser library that records a 2D, WebGL or WebGPU canvas into MP4, WebM, MKV, GIF or a PNG/JPG frame sequence. Encoders include WebCodecs (fast, no WASM), an embedded MP4 WASM encoder, an FFmpeg WASM encoder and plain frame dumps. Distinguishing strength: stepped frame-by-frame recording of generative canvas sketches without a headless browser, if your code can render on demand.
use_when: Canvas sketch you control that can render frame N on demand, exported in-browser
Over CCapture.js for a current WebCodecs MP4 path and WebGPU support
Quick MP4 or frame sequence from a three.js or p5.js canvas during interactive work
avoid_when: DOM, SVG or CSS scenes: Playwright captures the whole page
Server-side or CI renders: Playwright frames into FFmpeg
Alpha PNG sequences at scale: Playwright seek-and-screenshot capture is the validated route
notes: 2026-10-26: README does not cover Node or headless use; assumed browser-only. Not exercised.

assessment.rationale: Browser-only canvas recorder with WebCodecs, WASM, GIF and frame encoders; v6.0.0 published 2026-09-17, repo pushed same month. Useful for canvas sketches; Playwright remains VCR's capture route for everything else.
